request.description: All fields optional (at least one required). language: en|kn|hi. notificationPreferences is a partial object — only keys you send are changed. buyerType: BUYER|RENTER|INVESTOR. timeline: NOW|3_6_MONTHS|BROWSING. city here is the buyer's preferred city (stored as preferredCity), unrelated to a property's own city field.
Records onboarding consent. termsAccepted/privacyAccepted set a one-time acceptance timestamp (not revocable); marketingOptIn is a genuine toggle. Any subset of the three fields may be sent.
phone accepts any valid international number (via libphonenumber-js), not just Indian ones.
